title: The sinkhole opens twenty-eight lane hops out for real; the breach shot holds the whole planet through the emergence; a build tag top right
context: Owner: put a build number top right for debugging; the sinkhole still appears too close; when it breaches the camera should pan to the whole-planet view and stay there for the entire animation including enemies starting to emerge.
outcome: Measured on the real planet: the greedy outward walk stopped at a wiggle in the lane, nine hops out (92 m from the gate). base-plan now walks breadth first over open ground outside the clearing and takes the farthest-from-pole cell at exactly fodderSteps hops: 28 hops, 289 m from the gate; the base-plan test asserts the hop count. In the story the breach shot's duration is preRoll + breach duration + STORY_BREACH.emergeHold (6 s) + a 1.8 s tail, holding the orbit pose until the tail; the story-world acceptance sees the shot still on while the second fodder emerges. main.js stamps a build tag (release token or dev) top right.
alternatives: A metres target instead of hops: rejected for now, hops follow the lane and the tremor contact reads from the same cell.
evidence: node script over the bake: fodder hops 9 -> 28, chord gate->fodder 92 m -> 289 m
npm test 92, npm run check, node scripts/browser-test.mjs --story-world with story-world-breach-emerge
